forum.title: CubeMX 6.16 generated code: HAL_GetTick() always returns 0
forum.best_answer_content: thanks for your reply, I add 2 seconds in the "max halt timeout" and the problem solved.
forum.content_text:
Hi,

I use cubemx to generate code for STM32CubeIDE, compile is OK, but the initial process run fail with HAL\_Delay function, the HAL\_GetTick() always return 0 so the program blocked here.

attached is my .ioc file, any anyone help for thie issue?
forum.author: Jason57

scraped_replies.html:
The issue is likely in how and where you're using HAL_Delay in your code. Ensure interrupts stay enabled and ensure the tick interrupt gets serviced.

The TIM6 priority is 0 in the IOC which is the highest. No issues there.
scraped_replies.author: TDK

scraped_replies.html: thanks for your reply, I add 2 seconds in the "max halt timeout" and the problem solved.
scraped_replies.author: Jason57
